info.description: Autonomous delivery-integrity workflow engine for LUME streaming operations.
info.title: Fincher Media Delivery Operations API

get.description: Fetches territory deliveries with pagination, optionally filtered by title, country, or status.

parameters.description: Country code filter (e.g. US, ES, JP)
parameters.name: country

post.description: Schedules a territory release target with status and target premiere date.

get.description: Fetches territory release status, carrier details, and target shipping date.

patch.description: Updates territory release shipping state (e.g. HOLD, READY_TO_SHIP) or metadata.
patch.summary: Partial update of a delivery target

get.description: Fetches dependency edges with pagination, optionally filtered by parent or child package ID.

post.description: Registers a lineage edge between two packages with cycle prevention and same-title checks.

get.description: Traverses packages and dependency edges to build a recursive hierarchical tree from root video masters.
get.summary: Fetch lineage DAG tree for a title

delete.description: Removes a lineage edge between parent and child media packages.

get.description: Fetches master cut versions with pagination, optionally filtered by title_id.

post.description: Publishes a new master cut and updates Title.current_master_version.

get.description: Fetches master cut version and supersedes metadata.

delete.description: Removes an unused master cut entry.

get.description: Fetches media packages with pagination and optional filtering by title, vendor, component, or status.

post.description: Registers a video, audio dub, or subtitle package derived from a master cut.

get.description: Fetches package component, language, vendor, and derived master version.

delete.description: Removes a media package if no child dependencies exist.

patch.description: Updates package status (e.g. RE_QC_PENDING, INVALIDATED), master version cut, or metadata.
patch.summary: Partial update of a media package

get.description: Fetches releases in the launch calendar with pagination, optionally filtered by status.

parameters.description: Status filter (ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, HOLD, PROCESSING, SHIPPED)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Inserts a new release title into the launch calendar.

get.description: Fetches detailed launch metadata for a specific title.

delete.description: Removes a title if it has no dependent packages or masters.

patch.description: Updates specific fields (overall_status, master version, metadata) on a title.
patch.summary: Partial update of a media title

post.description: Uploads a raster image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF <= 1MB) stored directly in SQLite as binary BLOB.

get.description: Streams the raw binary image BLOB with caching and security headers.

delete.description: Removes an uploaded binary image from SQLite.

get.description: Fetches registered vendors with pagination, optionally filtered by specialty.

post.description: Registers a localization, dubbing, or subtitling facility.

get.description: Fetches post facility metadata, specialty, and contact tags.

delete.description: Removes a vendor if no dependent media packages exist.

patch.description: Updates vendor name, specialty, or metadata tags.
